title: Tamsin and the Postcards
author: Lior Lockridge
blurb: Casper Fairweather, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
